significance: A Digambar Jain tirtha of 103 temples across a 132-acre hill site near Datia, centred on an 11-foot image of Chandraprabhu known as Bade Baba; the temples date from the 9th century onwards over a much older rock-cut image.
story: Jain tradition holds that since the time of Chandraprabhu five and a half crore ascetics have attained moksha here, among them king Nanganang and half a million followers.
